Places blocks from its 9 slots in front of it, the first placeable one first, for 20 FE each (Wrought tier). It can face any direction.
- It places into air, water or anything replaceable, like grass, and waits while the front is blocked.
- Redstone: Always, With signal, Without signal, or Pulse.
# Cobblestone loop
A Block Breaker facing a cobblestone generator, feeding a Block Placer or a crate, runs on its own.
